goal: Rename the product from "Crate Digger" to "Frisson" everywhere it is the product name (npm packages, imports, UI copy, docs, Docker/CI naming, identifiers) with zero behaviour change and no orphaned data.
constraints: Pure rename, first PR; no behaviour changes beyond renamed identifiers.
Workspace names become: root frisson, @frisson/api, @frisson/web, @frisson/shared; all imports updated.
Keep SQLite file name crate.db, DATA_DIR, /data paths and the Docker named volume crate-data unchanged.
Do not edit Drizzle migration SQL or snapshot files (apps/api/drizzle/**).
The domain word crate (crates, CrateBox, crates table, crate-backup, crate-data) is not the product name and stays.
Regenerate package-lock.json with npm install, never by hand.
Out of scope: B-Side shared crates feature.
Typecheck, lint, test and build stay green.
assumptions: Display name is exactly "Frisson" (capitalised); slug is lowercase frisson; env/identifier form is frisson_session for the cookie.
Renaming SESSION_COOKIE (crate_digger_session) and the HMAC label 'crate-digger-session' invalidates existing logins once; accepted as part of the requested identifier rename.
Health endpoint service value crate-digger-api becomes frisson-api; tests updated to match; no external monitor depends on it.
Docker image tag becomes frisson (Dockerfile comment, CI tags/run).
Test fixtures (temp dir prefixes, test admin password 'crate-digger') are renamed too.
GitHub repo URL ThomF/crate-digger in docs/DEPLOY.md: the GitHub repo itself is not renamed in this PR, so the clone URL/directory name is allowlisted unless the owner renames the repo.
docs/adr historical text is rewritten to Frisson (owner listed docs/adr in scope).
README emoji heading is kept, only the name changes.
The compose.yaml has no top-level name:, so the Compose project name derives from the checkout directory; the directory is not renamed by this PR.
Existing allowlist for the grep check: package-lock.json is excluded from hand edits but must be regenerated and will contain no old names; .git, node_modules, .shipyard excluded.
risks: Compose prefixes volumes with the project name (directory name). If the repo directory is renamed to frisson on the server, crate-data becomes frisson_crate-data and data is orphaned. Mitigate: do not set or change project name; document in DEPLOY.md only if needed, or pin with name: crate-digger is NOT allowed by the grep check, so leave as is.
Cookie and HMAC label rename logs out existing sessions once.
Missed cross-workspace import breaks build; the case-insensitive grep and typecheck catch this.
Variant spellings (Crate-Digger, CrateDigger, crate_digger, crate digger) may escape a single regex.
package-lock.json regenerated with npm install may drift dependency versions; review the diff is limited to name changes.
Blanket find/replace could touch the domain word crate or migration files.
